- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Political Discontent: Many Europeans feel disillusioned with traditional political parties, leading them to support populist parties that promise to disrupt the status quo.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Summary: The complex interplay of economic, social, and political factors contribute to the rise of populism and nationalism in European politics.
